method: TypeScript TSX AST across all generated source files; assembly graph traversed recursively; native JSX text/CSS and local image/mask resources inspected separately. Counts describe registered source trees, not distinct design primitives or actual runtime DOM instances.
caveats: No asset dependency means native DOM/CSS/inline vector code, not a guarantee of responsive layout.
An external SVG is vector artwork, not a raster screenshot; embedded SVG paths remain opaque to the generic native text/color/motion API.
Asset-backed with no native text is not synonymous with a single flattened image: CSS geometry can still be native.
Registered roots, parts, assemblies and fragment assets must not be added together or treated as unique primitives.
